_comment: Fixed user-facing replies the server returns instead of (or appends to) a model answer. Per-language entries are picked by language_hint (default hinglish).
unverified: I couldn't verify that - please try again.

not_in_help.hinglish: Yeh help guide mein nahi hai. Aap Settings → 💬 Help & support se hamari team se baat kar sakte hain.
not_in_help.hi: यह हेल्प गाइड में नहीं है। आप Settings → 💬 Help & support से हमारी टीम से बात कर सकते हैं।
not_in_help.en: That's not in the help guide. You can reach our team from Settings → 💬 Help & support.

out_of_scope.hinglish: Main aapke khate (balance, udhaar, collection, recent entries) aur Bolcash app ke use ke sawaalon mein madad kar sakta hoon. Kisi aur cheez ke liye Settings → 💬 Help & support se hamari team se baat kariye.
out_of_scope.hi: मैं आपके खाते (बैलेंस, उधार, कलेक्शन, हाल की एंट्री) और Bolcash ऐप के इस्तेमाल के सवालों में मदद कर सकता हूँ। किसी और चीज़ के लिए Settings → 💬 Help & support से हमारी टीम से बात करें।
out_of_scope.en: I can help with your account (balances, dues, collections, recent entries) and with using the Bolcash app. For anything else, reach our team from Settings → 💬 Help & support.
